reason: A Windows-focused plugin for notifying users about agent events through desktop toasts, sounds, and offline Chinese text-to-speech, with configurable automatic and manual notification controls.

summaries.zh: 通过桌面通知、提示音和 Windows 离线中文语音播报提醒用户关注智能体任务完成、错误或需要处理的事件。
summaries.en: Notifies users about agent task completion, errors, and attention requests through Windows desktop alerts, sounds, and offline Chinese text-to-speech.

capabilities: Speaks notification messages using offline Windows SAPI text-to-speech
Plays system or synthesized notification sounds
Automatically notifies on agent turn completion or errors
Provides an agent notification tool and manual /notify command
Can adjust system volume during notifications when enabled
Injects notification guidance into agent system prompts when enabled
